content: One way of circumventing this problem is to anonymise the data by removing, replacing or obfuscating the personal information mentioned, as exemplified in Table TABREF1. This task can be done by hand, having people read and anonymise the documents one by one. Despite being a reliable and simple solution, this approach is tedious, expensive, time consuming and difficult to scale to the potentially thousands or millions of documents that need to be anonymised.
